futureCapabilities: Every Strategy other than Long Stock, and the remaining ten canonical Strategy seeds (D8, D9, D11, D12).
Position recording, Executions, Positions, Lots, FIFO Lot Matches, fees, realized P&L, and Planned becoming Open (D3).
Daily Review, Mark entry, Expected Mark Status, and Stop-Discipline deviation reconciliation (D4).
Corrections: Replace, Void, Rebuild, Correction Footprint, View history and audit history UI (D15, D16).
Close Reason, Abandonment Reason, Close Review and abandonPlan; no close or abandonment at D2 (D6).

Terminal Disposition, valuation, marked P&L, Overrun and Expiration Payoff: no Marks or disposing facts exist at D2.
The remaining five of seven Journal Entry Types and five of seven Sources, and the full seedDefaults manifest (D17).
Backup, Restore, migration of older Workspaces, installation and update (D7, D20, D21, D22).
Any latency claim; D2 asserts boundedness only and no timing statement (AC-PERF-001 is unowned).

entries.flowName: Ready to plan after D1 onboarding
actions: Ran `npm run build` (release 4b3417728eed325a5bbe9e191e5ec1dc8e8e0c291b391afddc2ac0fd91df64e1) and served dist with `npx vite preview --port 5177 --strictPort`.

Launched chromium.launchPersistentContext('/tmp/d2-critic-narrow', {headless:true, viewport:{width:375,height:812}}) against an empty profile directory, armed the harness init script (__TRADE_JOURNAL_HARNESS__ = true, __TRADE_JOURNAL_STARTUP_OVERRIDE__ = {}) and navigated to http://127.0.0.1:5177/.
The startup screen showed h2 "Create this journal"; selected Time zone America/New_York and pressed "Create this journal".
Completed D1 onboarding: nav Set up -> Institution name "Fidelity" -> "Add institution"; Institution = Fidelity, Account name "Brokerage One" -> "Add account".
Returned to Status and read the Onboarding line, then pressed the "Plan" button in navigation[name="Primary"] and waited for h2 "Confirm a plan"; measured the navigation and form geometry.
entries.observation: Fresh profile: startup showed h2 "Create this journal" with a 6-option Time zone select; pressing Create this journal produced navigation[name="Primary"] with exactly 4 buttons [Status, Set up, Plan, Trades]. Status read Onboarding "Needs Institution and Account" before onboarding and "Ready for Trade Planning" after adding Institution "Fidelity" and Account "Brokerage One"; "Installed capabilities 10 operations"; Release 4b3417728eed325a5bbe9e191e5ec1dc8e8e0c291b391afddc2ac0fd91df64e1, byte-identical to dist/release-inventory.json and to GET /release-inventory.json; readiness evidence 4/4 Passed (Authoritative storage, Storage capacity, Application release worker, Offline release inventory). The Plan button is button 3 of 4 in the bottom bar and opened the form at h2 "Confirm a plan": "Set up an Account first" 0, "Loading the plan form" 0, "The plan form could not be loaded" 0, i.e. Ready, not Loading/Empty/Error. Geometry at 375x812: nav box x=0 y=751 w=375 h=61, position=fixed, flex-direction=row (bottom navigation, flush to the bottom edge); plan form x=24 w=327, centre 188 = viewport centre 188; document.scrollWidth 375 (no horizontal scroll). The form rendered 20 controls with ids field-accountId, field-strategyStableKey, field-intendedEntry, field-instrumentKey, field-quantity, field-cond-1.boundaryPrice, field-cond-1.comment, field-cond-2.boundaryPrice, field-cond-2.comment, field-prompt.plan-reflection.thesis, field-prompt.plan-reflection.invalidation, field-prompt.plan-reflection.conviction and the 8 emotion radios.

entries.flowName: Reward-to-risk and maximum loss visible before Save
actions: Opened Plan and filled every field (Account, Strategy, entry 180, AAPL, 100, Stop 175, Target 190, both reflection answers) without saving.
Read the pre-Save disclosure: the provisional reward-to-risk and maximum loss, their labels, the section heading, and both per-condition derived monetary boundaries.
Pressed "Save the plan" exactly once and tried to read the frozen figures to compare, then recorded the alert, the durable counts and the Trades list.
entries.observation:
FAIL at the Save step. All pre-Save disclosure was present and correct: heading "Before you save (provisional)", dt "Reward-to-risk (provisional)" = "2", dt "Maximum loss (provisional)" = "500 USD", and the per-condition derivations rendered read-only as

text (no input, 0 labels containing "monetary") reading "Monetary boundary (derived): 500 USD" for the Stop and "Monetary boundary (derived): 1000 USD" for the Target - exactly 2 and 500 USD, and 500 / 1000 USD. But the single Save was rejected with "The Plan was not saved. Your entries are still here. / obligation plan-confirmation:1 already has a current outcome": "Plan confirmed" count 0, so no frozen figures appeared and the required comparison could not be made. Nothing was written (durable counts identical before/after: journal 3, tradeRecord 5, lifecycleIndex 1, tradeLifecycle 1, tradeVersion 1) and Trades still listed 1. Reproduction: fresh profile -> onboard -> confirm the canonical Plan once -> on "Plan confirmed" press "Start another plan" -> fill the same Plan -> Save -> the alert above. Root cause is visible in the same source tree: src/ui/PlanForm.tsx:41 hardcodes OBLIGATION_KEY = "plan-confirmation:1" and src/journal/effects.ts:327 rejects a journal obligation key that already has a current outcome, while the project's own integration case tests/integration/d2-confirm-plan.test.ts:311-317 confirms two Trades using "plan-confirmation:1" and "plan-confirmation:2" - so a second Plan confirmation in one Workspace can never succeed. Control run isolating the disclosure from the conflict: the identical steps in a fresh profile /tmp/d2-critic-f13-narrow did confirm and showed frozen reward-to-risk "2", maximum loss (frozen) "500 USD", 1R "500" and "These are the frozen figures. They are the provisional ones you saw before Save: freezing did not change them." - identical to the provisional figures, so the pre-Save disclosure requirement itself is met; the failure is that the Save cannot complete once one Trade exists.

entries.flowName: Reward-to-risk and maximum loss visible before Save
actions: Same steps at 1440x900: filled the complete Plan without saving, read the provisional figures, labels and both derived boundaries, then pressed Save once and recorded the outcome.
Repeated the same steps in a fresh profile /tmp/d2-critic-f13-wide as a control to separate the disclosure from the Save rejection.
entries.observation: FAIL at the Save step, identical to narrow. Pre-Save disclosure was correct: "Before you save (provisional)" with "Reward-to-risk (provisional)" = "2" and "Maximum loss (provisional)" = "500 USD", and read-only derivations "Monetary boundary (derived): 500 USD" (Stop) and "Monetary boundary (derived): 1000 USD" (Target). The single Save was rejected with "The Plan was not saved. Your entries are still here. / obligation plan-confirmation:1 already has a current outcome"; no "Plan confirmed" screen appeared, so the frozen figures could not be compared; values and the provisional preview stayed on screen and nothing was written (durable counts identical, Trades still 1). Control run in a fresh profile: the same steps produced frozen reward-to-risk "2", maximum loss "500 USD", 1R "500" and the frozen-equals-provisional sentence, i.e. identical to the provisional figures - the disclosure is sound and the defect is the rejected second confirmation.
